text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for Mihono Bourbon's debut. Nervousness is a foreign concept to her, but she offers to become nervous if it's required.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I send her off with instructions to run as hard as she can, knowing she'll carry out my orders like a well-calibrated machine.
